basis: The dashboard legend is inverted: the top of the scale is pale yellow next to “100 Low,” and the bottom is dark burgundy next to “0 High,” so darker burgundy encodes higher prevalence. Among the available option states, NY is filled with the darkest burgundy (near the High end), DE is light orange (mid-low), and NC is pale yellow (near the Low end). Therefore NY has the highest encoded prevalence among the options and should be routed to the highest-prevalence priority follow-up workflow.
option_label: Open New York (NY) prevalence detail for priority follow-up
